---
title: "Single-workbook supplementary tables"
format: html
---

Author decision, 22 September 2026: one Excel workbook with flat numbered
tables, not Supplementary Data packages. Packaging does not recalculate tests.
All tested transcriptome features are retained, including nonsignificant ones.
Plot coordinates and duplicated diagnostic exports are omitted.

```{python}
import csv, hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived')
out=root/'supplementary_workbook_2026-09-22-v1'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
tables=[]; provenance=[]
def read(rel):
 p=root/rel
 provenance.append({'source':rel,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
 with p.open() as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\t'))
def add(name,title,rows,scope):
 assert rows, name
 headers=list(dict.fromkeys(k for row in rows for k in row))
 # Convert only unambiguously numeric columns, never identifiers.
 numeric=[]
 for h in headers:
  vals=[str(r.get(h,'')) for r in rows if r.get(h,'') not in ('','NA','NaN',None)]
  numeric.append(bool(vals) and not re.search(r'(^id$|_id$|accession|sample|gene|contig)',h,re.I) and all(re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?',v) for v in vals))
 grid=[]
 for r in rows:
  row=[]
  for h,n in zip(headers,numeric):
   v=r.get(h,'NA')
   if n and v not in ('','NA','NaN',None):v=float(v)
   if v is None or v=='':v='NA'
   row.append(v)
  grid.append(row)
 num=len(tables)+1; sheet=f'S{num} {name}'
 assert len(sheet)<=31
 payload={'sheet':sheet,'title':title,'scope':scope,'headers':headers,'rows':grid,'numeric':numeric}
 (out/f'S{num}.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,allow_nan=False))
 tables.append({'Table':f'Supplementary Table S{num}','Sheet':sheet,'Title':title,'Rows':len(grid),'Scope':scope})
q='catalogue_sample_supplement_2026-09-22-v1/'
add('MAG quality','MAG quality and reference lengths',read(q+'MAG_quality.tsv'),'348 dereplicated MAGs. Completeness and contamination are percentages.')
add('vOTU quality','vOTU quality and taxonomy',read(q+'vOTU_quality.tsv'),'634-vOTU abundance catalogue. Distinct from the CRISPR-linked viral sequences.')
c='community_cycle_models_catalogue_aligned_2026-09-16-v1/tables/'
rows=[]
for community in ['mag','votu']:
 for test in ['main_wald','interaction_lrt']:
  rows += [dict(community=community,test=test,**r) for r in read(c+community+'_'+test+'.tsv')]
add('Abundance tests','Complete MAG and vOTU differential-abundance tests',rows,'Separate main-condition Wald and joint cycle-interaction tests. Adjustment columns retain their original testing families.')
add('Concordance','Cross-omics Bray-Curtis concordance',read('community_cross_omics_permutation_2026-09-16-v3/tables/bray_curtis_matrix_permutation_tests.tsv'),'Global and constrained permutation P values, with separate BH correction across three assay pairs.')
add('Turnover','Successive-cycle community turnover',read('community_cross_omics_2026-09-15-v3/cycle_turnover.tsv'),'Descriptive Bray-Curtis dissimilarity within each condition and sampling phase.')
add('MAG contributions','MAG genomic and transcriptional contributions',read('community_cross_omics_2026-09-15-v3/MAG_contributions.tsv'),'Mean MG and MT read shares and taxonomic assignments.')
edges=read('figure1_shared_taxonomy_2026-09-14-v3/tables/plotted_network_edges.tsv')
edges=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ['host_y','phage_y','phage_degree']} for r in edges]
viral={r['phage_id']:r for r in read('figure1_shared_taxonomy_2026-09-14-v3/tables/viral_node_quality.tsv')}
for r in edges:
 for k in ['completeness','completeness_method','checkv_quality','miuvig_quality','viral_genes','warnings']:r['viral_'+k]=viral[r['phage_id']][k]
add('Host phage links','CRISPR-derived host-phage links',edges,'86 links involving 80 host MAGs and 85 viral sequences. These viral sequences are outside the 634-vOTU abundance catalogue.')
d='full_transcriptome_de/tables/'
main=read(d+'de_condition_adjusted.tsv'); inter=read(d+'de_condition_cycle_interaction_omnibus.tsv')
assert len(main)==len(inter)==361907
joint={r['feature_id']:r for r in inter};assert len(joint)==len(inter)
rows=[]
for r in main:
 j=joint[r['feature_id']]
 rows.append({**{k:r[k] for k in ['feature_id','gene_id','MAG_ID','gene_symbol','annotation']},'main_logFC':r['logFC'],'main_P':r['p_value'],'main_FDR_BH':r['FDR'],'interaction_P':j['p_value'],'interaction_FDR_BH':j['FDR'],'interaction_cycle2_logFC':j['logFC.cycle2.conditiontreatment'],'interaction_cycle3_logFC':j['logFC.cycle3.conditiontreatment']})
lookup={r['feature_id']:r for r in rows}
cp=root/d/'de_condition_cycle_interaction_coefficients.tsv'
provenance.append({'source':str(cp.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(cp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
with cp.open() as f:
 for r in csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\t'):
  label=r['coefficient'].split(':')[0]
  assert label in ['cycle2','cycle3']
  for old,new in [('p_value','P'),('FDR','FDR_BH')]:lookup[r['feature_id']]['interaction_'+label+'_'+new]=r[old]
assert all(len(r)==16 for r in rows)
add('Transcriptome tests','Complete transcriptome-wide differential-expression results',rows,'All 361,907 tested features. Main model: phase + cycle + condition. Interaction model: phase + cycle * condition. Includes joint 2-df tests and both interaction coefficients. BH corrections retain their original endpoint-specific families.')
del lookup
del main,inter,joint,rows
bio=read('biofilm_sos_supplementary_table_2026-09-13-v1/supplementary_biofilm_SOS_gene_evidence.tsv')
bio=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ['experimental_unit_caveat','annotation_source','annotation_match_status']} for r in bio]
add('Biofilm SOS genes','Combined biofilm and SOS gene evidence',bio,'3,905 combined biofilm memberships and 523 SOS memberships. Includes annotation matching provenance, MAG assignments and full-transcriptome adjusted tests. Historical flags explain the combined union only.')
add('Concentration','Gene concentration randomisation tests',read('mag_functional_concentration_combined_2026-09-13-v1/tables/global_concentration.tsv'),'Observed MAG concentration against the stated randomisation null; original Monte Carlo uncertainty and FDR columns.')
add('Dependence','Block-level concentration sensitivity',read('mag_concentration_dependence_combined_2026-09-13-v1/tables/dependence_results.tsv'),'10-kb, 50-kb and contig-level dependence sensitivity. Unit, endpoint and multiple-testing scope remain explicit.')
add('MAG gene contributors','MAG-resolved biofilm and SOS contributors',read('figure4_functional_notation_2026-09-20-v4/tables/all_MAG_contributors.tsv'),'All MAG contributors, not only displayed labels.')
add('Genomic eligibility','Priority-MAG genomic comparison eligibility',read('priority20_supplement_audit_2026-09-22-v1/priority20_eligibility.tsv'),'All 20 priority MAGs. Missing audit records remain unavailable, not zero differences.')
add('Genomic comparisons','Pairwise genomic comparisons and callable denominators',read('instrain_denominator_audit_2026-09-09/pair_denominator_sensitivity.tsv'),'191 audited pairs; qualification fields identify the 139 retained comparisons.')
add('Population clusters','Qualified MAG population clusters',read('figure6_population_heterogeneity_2026-09-20-v1/tables/population_genomics_cluster_panel.tsv'),'Sample-level population-cluster assignments for the five qualified MAGs.')
score=read('cleaning_performance_score_2026-09-14-v1/scores.tsv')
components=read('cleaning_performance_score_2026-09-14-v1/release_components.tsv')
ref=read('cleaning_performance_score_2026-09-14-v1/frozen_reference.tsv')
for r in score:
 for x in components:
  if x['condition']==r['condition'] and x['cycle']==r['cycle']:
   for k in ['initial','backflush']:r[x['outcome']+'_'+k]=x[k]
 for x in ref:
  for k in ['mean','sample_sd']:r[x['component']+'_reference_'+k]=x[k]
add('Cleaning score','Cleaning-score readouts and fixed reference constants',score,'Initial/(initial+backflush) ratios averaged equally across three readouts. The standardized mean ratio and exact TMP lag each contribute 50% to the score.')
add('Candidate models','All 14 candidate MAG model estimates',read('cleaning_score_condition_models_2026-09-14-v1/all_specifications.tsv'),'168 fits: 14 MAGs, DNA/RNA predictors, two phases and three specifications. FDR_56 and FDR_168 denote separate correction scopes; HC3 columns are robust-error sensitivities.')
add('Suppression','Candidate 50-percent suppression scenarios',read('figure7_candidate_suppression_2026-09-15-v3/tables/50_percent_intervals.tsv'),'Modelled changes in the fixed cleaning-performance score, not percentages of biofilm reduction. Includes coefficient-derived uncertainty.')
add('All MAG models','All-MAG abundance model context',read('cleaning_score_all_MAG_models_2026-09-21-v1/tables/models_annotated.tsv'),'2,088 fits. FDR_696 is within specification; FDR_2088 is across all fits. Candidate membership and gene-response categories remain explicit.')
add('Samples','Physical sample metadata',read(q+'Samples.tsv'),'12 physical samples; sequencing runs are not additional biological samples.')
add('Sequencing runs','ENA sequencing-run crosswalk',read(q+'Sequencing_runs.tsv'),'47 sequencing runs mapped to 12 physical samples.')
p=root/'supplementary_mapping_table_2026-09-22-v1/Supplementary_Table_S2.md'
provenance.append({'source':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
blocks=[];current=[]
for line in p.read_text().splitlines()+['']:
 if line.startswith('|'):current.append([v.strip() for v in line.strip('|').split('|')])
 elif current:blocks.append(current);current=[]
a,b=blocks
mapping=[dict(zip(a[0],r)) for r in a[2:]]
second={(r[0],r[1]):dict(zip(b[0],r)) for r in b[2:]}
for r in mapping:r.update({k:v for k,v in second[(r['Sample'],r['Assay'])].items() if k not in ['Sample','Assay']})
add('Mapping','Coassembly alignment records and catalogue counts',mapping,'Coassembly mapped fractions include secondary/supplementary alignment records. Catalogue-assigned counts are separate unnormalised CoverM totals and are not divided by coassembly totals.')
s='16s_analysis/09_return_package/'
add('16S diversity','Retained 16S v1 alpha diversity',read(s+'16s_alpha_diversity.tsv'),'Returned v1 analysis of 12 samples. No v2 differential-abundance results.')
add('16S PERMANOVA','Retained 16S v1 community tests',read(s+'16s_beta_permanova.tsv'),'Returned permutation P values; do not interpret them as BH-adjusted values.')
add('Functional categories','Competitive functional-category tests',read('full_de_interpretation/tables/functional_category_enrichment.tsv'),'Eight categories tested downstream of complete-transcriptome DE. BH correction separately for each coefficient.')
add('Recurrence','Recurrent-gene condition differences',read('recurrence_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v2/tables/recurrent_gene_heatmap_cells.tsv'),'24 displayed recurrent genes across six phase-cycle combinations. log2cpm_difference is treatment minus control; descriptive recurrence is not an independent differential-expression test.')
(out/'INDEX.json').write_text(json.dumps(tables,indent=2))
(out/'PROVENANCE.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(tables,indent=2))
```
